translationRepairs: The house of Zhou received its sign when a white fish leaped into King Wu's boat, and he offered it to Heaven in a burnt sacrifice.
The house of Zhou received its sign when a fish leaped into the boat, and marked it as auspicious with a burnt offering.
s0207 has only 周躍魚隕杭，休之以燎: Zhou, a fish leaping into the boat, and an auspicious burnt offering. It never names 武王 or calls the fish 白, so those details are invented English.
From me heaven covers, clouds oily-oily.
Since Heaven covers us, the clouds roll thickly.

The before gloss is unintelligible: 油油 describes thickly rolling clouds, not oil, and 自我天覆 is Heaven covering us. The proposal fixes that sense but “From our Heaven covering us” awkwardly attaches 我 to Heaven; “Since Heaven covers us” tracks the Chinese cleanly.
Tang and Wu held the highest rank yet never dropped their awe; Shun, though enthroned by borrowed forms, still reviewed his faults. This is the sense of it.
Tang and Wu held the highest rank yet never dropped their awe; Shun, while dwelling in the great canons, still reviewed his faults. This is the sense of it.
In 舜在假典, 假 is the classical “great” reading and 典 the canons/statutes; “enthroned by borrowed forms” invents a borrowing sense not supported by the phrase.
Therefore Tang and Wu, though supremely honored, did not lose reverent awe; Shun, dwelling in borrowed ritual texts, looked back and examined his oversights: this is what is meant.
Therefore Tang and Wu, though supremely honored, did not lose reverent awe; Shun, dwelling in the great canons, looked back and examined his oversights: this is what is meant.
The same 假典 in s0256 is “great canons,” not “borrowed ritual texts”; the proposed literal restores that sense without other changes.
Eight years later he worshiped the central peak, performed the feng on Mount Tai, went on to Liangfu, and the shan at Suyan.
Eight years after Xiangru's death he worshiped the central peak, performed the feng on Mount Tai, went on to Liangfu, and the shan at Suyan.
s0257 sets the clock with 相如既卒五歲; s0258’s 八年而遂 continues from that death, not from the Hou Tu rite. “Eight years later” after s0257 wrongly suggests eight years after the sacrifice.
